subject: floating pillar
text: Stepping onto the switch directly in front of the upper level entrance causes a floating pillar below to rise to the top, providing access to the upper level of the dungeon.

evidence.quote: Step onto the switch directly in front of you, and one of the floating pillars below will rise to the top, giving you access to the upper level of the dungeon should you fall.

subject: giant Dodongo's skull
text: Dropping bombs through the catwalk gaps into both of the giant Dodongo skull's eye sockets causes the skull to open its mouth, granting access to the final area of the dungeon.

evidence.quote: Using your new bombs, drop bombs through the gaps in the catwalk so that they land in the giant Dodongo's skulls eye sockets (press the C-Button assigned to Bombs twice to drop bombs).  Igniting blasts in both eye sockets will cause the skull to open it's mouth, letting you access the last area of the dungeon.

subject: chest
text: A chest behind a sealed wall at the end of the catwalk contains a replacement Deku Shield, or a blue rupee if Link already has one.

evidence.quote: Before you drop down and enter the Dodongo's mouth, run to the end of the catwalk and blow open the sealed wall.  Open the chest for a replacement Deku Shield, or a blue rupee if you still have your old one.

subject: Dodongo's mouth
text: Entering the giant Dodongo's mouth on the central platform in the Antechamber leads inside to the next door.

evidence.quote: Drop down to the central platform in the Antechamber and enter the Dodongo's mouth.  Enter the door inside.

subject: Fire Keese
text: Fire Keese flap around the large pit area in the Back Room.

evidence.quote: Drop down into the large pit area.  Kill the Fire Keese flapping around the room, then climb up the ledge to the east.

subject: darkened tunnel
text: Climbing up the ledge to the east and running through the darkened tunnel leads to the Goron Graveyard.

evidence.quote: Drop down into the large pit area.  Kill the Fire Keese flapping around the room, then climb up the ledge to the east.  Run through the darkened tunnel to the next room.

subject: Fire Keese
text: Two Fire Keese swoop into the pit on the other side of the tunnel in Goron Graveyard.

evidence.quote: Jump down into the pit on the other side of the tunnel, and watch out for the two Fire Keese who will come swooping in.

subject: sealed wall
text: Dropping a bomb next to the sealed wall in the pit breaks it open to reveal a door.

evidence.quote: There is a sealed wall here.  Climb up next to it and drop a bomb next to the wall to break it open.  Go through the door on the other side.

subject: Gold Skulltula
text: A Gold Skulltula is located behind an Armos Knight statue and can be killed with the Slingshot to collect its token.

evidence.quote: This room contains a single Gold Skulltula, behind an Armos Knight statue.  Normally, you'd have to kill the Armos Knight to reach the Gold Skulltula, but not so this time.  Kill the Gold Skulltula with your Slingshot, then carefully move forward to grab the token without touching the Knight.

subject: Armos Knight
text: If accidentally brushed against, the Armos Knight can be defeated using Bombs.

evidence.quote: If you do accidentally brush against the Armos Knight, use your Bombs to defeat him.

subject: pots
text: Breaking the pots in the pit at the end of the ledge yields recovery items and a Fairy.

evidence.quote: Run to the end of the ledge, and jump down into the pit.  Break the pots to find recovery items and a Fairy (put it in a bottle if you have a spare).

subject: western door
text: Pushing the brown stone block into the opening in the center of the floor unlocks the western door.

evidence.quote: Once it's far enough away that you can move around to it's other side, push the block into the opening in the floor in center of the room, and the western door will unlock.

subject: chest
text: A chest on the far end of the room contains Bombs.

evidence.quote: Open the chest on the other end of the room to get some Bombs, then drop a Bomb onto the iron plate in the middle of the room.

subject: iron plate
text: Dropping a Bomb onto the iron plate in the center of the room causes it to disintegrate, allowing access to the pit below.

evidence.quote: Open the chest on the other end of the room to get some Bombs, then drop a Bomb onto the iron plate in the middle of the room.  After the bomb explodes, the plate will disintegrate, letting you drop down the pit into the room below.

subject: King Dodongo
text: Throwing a Bomb into King Dodongo's mouth while he inhales stuns him, making him vulnerable to a sword Jump Attack.

evidence.quote: In order to damage him, you must wait for him to begin inhaling in the first phase, and quickly throw a Bomb into his mouth.  The bomb will explode in his stomach, stunning the King Dodongo for a few seconds.  You are given only one sword swing when he is stunned, so make it a Jump Attack.

subject: King Dodongo
text: Standing on the edge of the lava or in one of the room's corners avoids King Dodongo's rolling attack during his second phase.

evidence.quote: After you have hurt Dodongo, he will begin his second phase.  Stand on the edge of the lava or in one of the corners of the room to avoid his rolling attack.

subject: King Dodongo
text: King Dodongo will die after taking three Jump Attacks or six normal sword attacks.

evidence.quote: After three Jump Attacks or six normal sword attacks, King Dodongo will die.

subject: King Dodongo
text: King Dodongo leaves behind a Heart Container upon defeat.

evidence.quote: Grab the Heart Container he leaves behind, and enter the ring of light to warp back outside, where Darunia will give you the Goron's Ruby, and make you an official Blood Brother.

subject: Darunia
text: After defeating King Dodongo and entering the ring of light, Darunia rewards Link with the Goron's Ruby and makes him an official Blood Brother.

evidence.quote: Grab the Heart Container he leaves behind, and enter the ring of light to warp back outside, where Darunia will give you the Goron's Ruby, and make you an official Blood Brother.

subject: Gold Skulltula
text: Blasting open an oddly-colored section of wall with a Bomb reveals a Gold Skulltula that can be killed with the Slingshot to collect its token.

evidence.quote: Kill the Tektites, then look for the oddly-shaped and oddly-colored bit of wall.  Use a Bomb to blast open the wall, then use the Slingshot to kill the Gold Skulltula on the inside.  The wall is climbable; climb up it to grab the Token.

subject: chest
text: Blowing open another odd wall section past the Red Flag reveals a chest containing a 50 rupee piece.

evidence.quote: Turn right at the Red Flag, and keep heading for Goron City.  You'll find another odd part of wall identical to the one that hid the Gold Skulltula.  Blow it open if you like, but don't open the chest inside unless you need rupees - it contains a 50 rupee piece.

subject: chests
text: The chests at the end of the boulder maze contain two fifty rupee pieces.

evidence.quote: The chests contains two more fifty rupee pieces - save them for later if your Adult's Wallet is maxed.

subject: crate
text: Rolling into the crate at the end of the boulder maze exposes a Gold Skulltula that yields a token.

evidence.quote: Roll into the crate here to destroy it, and kill the Gold Skulltula that appears.  Take it's token, and return to the main part of Goron City.

subject: Biggoron
text: Stopping the rolling Biggoron with a bomb inside the northern tunnel on the third floor rewards the Bomb Bag x30.

evidence.quote: Drop down to the third level of the city (the level directly beneath the top floor), where there is a Biggoron rolling around the level in a giant loop.  You can stop him by placing a bomb in his path so that it explodes just as he passes over it.  If you do this while he is passing through the tunnel in the northern part of the third floor, then he will give you the Bomb Bag x30 as a reward for your daring.

subject: giant pot
text: Throwing a bomb into the rotating giant pot so that it lands inside and stops on the happy face rewards a Piece of Heart.

evidence.quote: From the second level, you can throw bombs into the giant pot.  If you successfully land a bomb inside the pot, then it will begin to spin rapidly, finally coming to a stop.  If it stops on the side with the happy face, then you will get a Piece of Heart.

subject: secret passage
text: A secret passage on the second level of Goron City leads directly to the Lost Woods.

evidence.quote: Once you have the Piece of Heart, climb back up to the second level of Goron City and use the secret passage to go to the Lost Woods.

subject: Cow
text: A pit hidden beneath the boulder at the top of the ledges contains a Cow that replenishes Milk when Epona's Song is played.

evidence.quote: The last boulder at the top of the ledges hides a pit, which contains, among other things, a Cow which you can use to replenish your supply of Milk (play Epona's Song).

subject: volcano eruptions
text: Crouching under the Hylian Shield with R absorbs damage when shadows appear from falling volcanic lava.

evidence.quote: After a short distance, the volcano will begin erupting, spewing lava down onto you.  When you see the shadow beneath you, hide under the Hylian Shield with R to absorb the damage.

subject: Kaepora Gaebora
text: Kaepora Gaebora waits at the highest peak of Death Mountain and offers a ride back down to Kakariko Village if spoken to.

evidence.quote: Kaepora Gaebora waits for you here.  DO NOT SPEAK TO HIM.  If you do, he'll give you a ride back down the mountain to Kakariko Village, which you don't want to do just yet.

subject: oddly-colored wall cave
text: Bombing the oddly-colored wall to the left of Kaepora Gaebora opens an entrance to a cave.

evidence.quote: Bomb the oddly-colored wall to the left of KG, and enter the cave.

subject: Business Scrub
text: In a hidden pit beneath a boulder, a defeated Business Scrub will increase the number of Deku Nuts Link can carry for forty rupees.

evidence.quote: Use a Bomb to blow up the boulder in the corner of this crossroads.  Drop down the pit, and defeat both of the Business Scrubs inside with your Slingshot.  One of them will increase the number of Deku Nuts you can carry for forty rupees.
